controls.label: Enabled
controls.meaning: Off effects pass sound through; off inputs and outputs contribute silence.

controls.label: Bypass
controls.meaning: Bypassed effects pass sound through; bypassed inputs, outputs and Mixers contribute silence.

recordings.title: Enabled and Bypass: Gain example (silent)
recordings.description: A silent configuration recording of the shared Enabled and Bypass switches, shown on Gain. It shows their On/Off labels and status messages, then returns to the top of Properties. This is a control walkthrough, not an audible comparison.
